title: Condon's front line: Wild Bill Davison and Edmund Hall
summary: Leeman praises Wild Bill Davison, who brings him to Switzerland annually, and Edmund Hall as soloists he loved to play behind.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: But they had a format, that front line, Wild Bill Davison, all through the years with me playing down there with him, a great cornet player, who is well reknowned now, but I got to know him backwards, that's why they bring me over to Switzerland every year to play
with them in the Swiss jazz sessions they have. And Edmund Hall, anybody that would know -- some of the great critics and so forth -- recognize Edmund Hall.
Well, we want you to tell it, Cliff, because you played with him.
It was a wonderful, wonderful thing to play with him and behind him. And that man --
